title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
We are supporting a fantastic business based in Lichfield to recruit an Accounts Payable Assistant to join their finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented finance professional looking to gain experience within a fast-paced environment. This is a 4-week temporary contract with the potential to become permanent.

Reporting to the Accounts Payable Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring supplier invoices are processed accurately and payments are made on time. You will work closely with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers, helping to maintain strong relationships while supporting the smooth running of the finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices, ensuring accurate coding and timely posting.
- Matching purchase orders, invoices and delivery notes.
- Preparing supplier payment runs and processing employee expenses.
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies.
- Handling supplier and internal queries via phone and email.
- Assisting with month-end finance activities and reporting requirements.
- Supporting continuous improvements across accounts payable processes and procedures.

About You
- Previous experience within an Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger or Finance Assistant role would be advantageous.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable using finance or ERP systems.
- Able to manage workloads effectively and meet deadlines.
- Confident communicator with a proactive and professional approach.
- A finance-related qualification or degree would be beneficial but is not essential.

If you are immediately available and seeking you next role in Accounts Payable, please apply directly below!

title: Credit controller
description:

Credit Controller (3-Month Fixed-Term Contract)

Location: Cannock, Staffordshire (5 days per week onsite)
Salary: £30,000 equivalent pro rata
Contract: 3-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Start Date: Immediate Start Available

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Credit Controller to join a busy finance team on a 3-month fixed-term contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a driven and organised individual who can hit the ground running and support the business in maintaining strong cash flow and reducing aged debt.

Based onsite in Cannock five days per week, you will play a key role in managing customer accounts, ensuring timely collections, and building effective relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively manage and collect outstanding debt across a portfolio of customer accounts.
- Contact customers by telephone and email to secure prompt payment.
- Investigate and resolve invoice queries and payment disputes efficiently.
- Produce and review aged debt reports, highlighting high-risk accounts.
- Allocate incoming payments and reconcile customer accounts.
- Maintain accurate records of all collection activity and customer communications.
- Work closely with sales, customer service, and finance teams to resolve issues impacting payment.
- Support month-end processes and reporting requirements.
- Ensure adherence to company credit control policies and procedures.

About You
- Previous experience in a Credit Controller, Accounts Receivable, or Collections position.
- Proven ability to manage and reduce aged debt.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- Confident working with high volumes of customer accounts.
- Good attention to detail and accurate record-keeping skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and finance systems.
- Ability to work independently and prioritise workload effectively.
- Available to start immediately or at short notice.

Benefits
- Immediate start opportunity.
- Competitive salary of £30,000 equivalent pro rata.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Valuable experience within a fast-paced finance function.
- Free onsite parking.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Credit Controller available for an immediate start and looking for your next contract opportunity in Cannock, we would love to hear from you.

title: Payroll Administrator
company: XPERT RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Payroll Administrator
Permanent
Monday - Thursday 8am - 4.15pm Friday 8am - 3pm
Stoke on Trent £28,000

We're looking for an organised and detail-focused Payroll Administrator to join a busy and supportive People & Culture team.

If you're someone who genuinely enjoys working with numbers, takes pride in getting the detail right and likes knowing that your work directly impacts people across the business, this could be a great opportunity for you.

You'll be responsible for supporting the smooth and accurate running of payroll, making sure employees are paid correctly and on time, whilst providing a reliable and professional service to colleagues and managers.

Key Responsibilities
Working alongside the Payroll Manager, you'll provide day-to-day administrative support across the payroll function.
From processing payroll information and maintaining employee records to dealing with queries, supporting pension administration and assisting with statutory payments, you'll play an important part in keeping everything running smoothly and meeting key payroll deadlines.
- Supporting the accurate and timely processing of payroll
- Ensuring payroll deadlines are consistently met
- Maintaining accurate employee payroll records, including starter and leaver information
- Processing payroll changes, deductions and other relevant information
- Assisting with holiday calculations and statutory payments
- Supporting pension administration
- Producing and completing payroll reports accurately and within required timescales
- Responding to payroll queries from employees and managers and resolving issues wherever possible
- Supporting the Payroll Manager with year-end activities and key payroll deadlines
- Keeping payroll systems and employee information accurate and up to date
- Staying informed of relevant payroll legislation and best practice
- Looking for opportunities to improve payroll processes and ways of working
- Ensuring all payroll information is handled with the highest level of confidentiality
- Working in line with company procedures and compliance requirements

Skills & Experience Required
- We're looking for someone who already has some hands-on payroll experience and is ready to build on that within a supportive team.
- You'll ideally have:
- Around 1-2 years' recent experience working within a payroll environment
- A good understanding of payroll processes and relevant legislation
- Experience using computerised payroll systems
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook
- GCSE Maths and English (or equivalent) at Grade 4-9
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work
- The ability to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage your own workload
- A professional and approachable manner
- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to deal with payroll queries
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a wider team
- A high level of discretion when handling confidential employee information

The benefits

You'll be joining a professional People & Culture team where you'll have the support and training you need to settle into the role and develop your knowledge.

The benefits package includes:
- Company pension, free pension advice and life insurance
- Healthcare Cash Plan
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Occupational Health Screening
- Health & Wellbeing Programme
- Enhanced annual leave
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay
- Bereavement leave and company sick pay
- Cycle to Work Scheme
- Discounted products
- Free on-site parking
- Employee referral scheme
- Long Service Awards
- Reward & Recognition Programme
- Company events
- Pre-retirement scheme
- Casual dress

If you're looking for a role where you can make a real impact behind the scenes and be part of a people-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you. title: Payroll and Benefits Officer
description:
Payroll and Benefits Officer (Part time - 24 hours per week)
Staffordshire £30-32 K (Pro Rata) Permanent
We're looking for an experienced payroll professional to take ownership of a varied, standalone payroll position based in Staffordshire.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting stuck into the detail. The payroll currently involves a mixture of manual processes, so you'll need to be comfortable working this way whilst also supporting the business as it continues to move towards more digital ways of working.

The role will include:
- Managing payroll for up to 250 employees
- Processing a mixture of lunar and monthly payrolls
- Managing different pay types including hourly, minimum wage and salaried employees
- Supporting a separate pensioner payroll linked to a final salary scheme
- Processing payroll using Sage 50 Payroll
- Managing pensions, including auto-enrolment and annual pension audits
- Working with pension providers including Aviva and The People's Pension
- Managing timesheets and ensuring payroll is processed accurately and on time
- Helping to improve and digitalise existing payroll processes

What we're looking for!
- You'll be an experienced payroll professional who is confident managing a busy and occasionally complex payroll.
- Previous experience using Sage 50 Payroll is important, and exposure to Sage HR would be beneficial.
- You'll also be comfortable working with manual processes, rather than expecting everything to be fully automated from day one.
- Experience of payrolls involving different rates, pay structures or employee groups would be particularly useful.

The role is part time, and we are looking for the successful candidate to work Mondays and Thursdays in office, with some flexibility around the working pattern.

If you're looking for a part-time payroll role where you can genuinely take ownership and help shape how the function works moving forward, this could be a really good fit.

Application Disclaimer: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.
Thank you for taking the time to apply.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk

If you are an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk or Finance Administrator with a proven background in working within a fast paced, motivated team and business, then read on

Consult KA have partnered with a successful services based business who have an incredible UK customer base. This is a hands-on, short-term opportunity suited to someone with relevant purchase ledger experience who is organised, detail-focused and comfortable working to daily deadlines.

As the Purchase Ledger Clerk you will provide support to the Finance Manager and help keep the purchase ledger processes running smoothly during a period of change.

You will be working as part of a small and relaxed office team for a period of 4-6 weeks. The ideal person must have the ability to pick up the Purchase Ledger quickly, managing processes, work accurately and provide reliable support.

What we need from you?

A detailed orientated person who can support the business in ensuring that invoices and payments are properly approved, someone who has the ability to liaise confidently with various department and keep track of what is owed to vendors.

What you need to succeed?

An individual who can
- Work in a fast-paced environment and be confident managing complex invoices
- Take full responsibility for the maintenance and administration of the purchase ledger including matching, batching, and coding of invoices, supplier statement reconciliations, query resolution,liaising with various internal and external colleagues
- Create supplier payment runs on the SAGE system.
- Ability to foster positive working relationships with both internal departments and external customers.
- Daily csv production for uploading into SAGE.
- Be confident using SAGE however not essential

Essential Details

Position - Purchase Ledger Clerk

Location - Newcastle under Lyme

Contract - Temporary 4-6 weeks

Rate - £14 per hour (£28k permanent salary equivalent)

Think you've got what we need?
